tasks.final_text: Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The original facility (spelled Shoppers' World) i sof historical significance as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.

This morning I was riding on my bike through Tucson. I started in Tucson and headed south on a bike path and then cruised towards Sahuarita and ended in a little town in Green Valley. I stopped for coffee at a little cofee shop for a little while, and then headed home. I had a tailwind on the way back and was able to cruise speedily and smoothly.
